nodes.text:
The Minister of Health,@Fmohnigeria Muhammad Ali Pate, has directed port health officers to screen arriving passengers for symptoms associated with HMPV. 

Port Health Services have been mandated to conduct thorough checks on passengers from international flights upon arrival. https://t.co/f4kOXKqCkR

nodes.author: aaziz_musa
nodes.text: 🇳🇬 Nigeria has initiated enhanced health screenings at major international airports, including Murtala Muhammad Intern Airport in Lagos and Nnamdi Azikiwe International  Airport in Abuja, in response to the spread of Human Metapneumovirus (HMPV) from China to several countries.
